name: Bergland
beschreibung:
Overview

The Hotel Bergland is a traditional three-star hotel in Plangeroß, a hamlet of the municipality of St. Leonhard im Pitztal in Tyrol. The accommodation is located at Plangeroß 43, 6481 St. Leonhard im Pitztal, and is presented as a family-run house of the Santeler-Dobler family. The hosts include Katrin and Michael with their sons Julian and Florian as well as the seniors Irmgard and Alois. The hotel sees itself as a three-generation house with honest hospitality and emphasises its closeness to the nature of the Tyrolean Alps. Guests stay in several room categories such as the Pitztal, Bergland, Herzblut and Mittagskogel double rooms, a single room and a holiday apartment in the adjoining house. The amenities include, among other things, a sauna and an infrared cabin for relaxing after an active day. The kitchen relies on ingredients from the region, prepared according to traditional recipes, accompanied by wines from the hotel's own wine cellar.

History/Background

According to its own account, the Santeler-Dobler family has held Pitztal tourism dear for generations. The story begins with Alois Dobler Sr., who was significantly involved in the creation of the Rifflsee and glacier cable cars and was already welcoming guests in his guesthouse in 1951. In 1978 Alois Jr. and his wife Irmgard took over the Gasthof Bergland and turned it into a home for family and guests. In 2005 their daughter Katrin, together with her husband Michael, brought new momentum to the house by taking over the business. In the meantime it has become a varied three-generation house.

Getting there

By car, the Pitztal can be reached via the Inntal motorway A12, Imst/Pitztal exit; from the north, the route via Garmisch and the Fernpass is also possible. By train, travel to Imst-Pitztal station and from there take the public bus to the hotel; on request, the house organises a shuttle transfer. According to the tourist board, Innsbruck Airport is around 90 kilometres away, and the nearest railway station around 35 kilometres. The nearest bus stop is around 200 metres from the establishment. As a partner of the Pitztal Sommer Card, free arrival and departure by bus is possible via the mobile guest card.

Tips

The hotel is a partner of the Pitztal Sommer Card and offers access to 16 attractions and 4 bonus partners from June to October. Winter guests benefit from the proximity to the Rifflsee mountain railways (around 2 km) and the Pitztaler Glacier (around 3 km); the Hochzeiger mountain railways are around 27 km away. Sauna and infrared cabin are available for relaxation, and regional specialities from the hotel's own kitchen for your physical well-being. The team is happy to pass on practical tips on activities and excursion destinations.

Best time to travel

The hotel is geared towards winter and summer holidays. In winter, skiing, ski tours and winter hikes in the Pitztal are the focus, in summer hiking, mountaineering and climbing around the Kaunergrat Nature Park. A specific, generally recommended travel time is not documented; the choice depends on the respective activity offerings of the season.
